purpose: Canonical filesystem arborescence for CYNIC — Single Source of Truth for all filesystem paths. Every path in the codebase MUST reference this document; no hardcoded paths outside it are permitted.

git_sources.description: Versioned declarative desired-state. Git is their engine. Never duplicated into databases.
git_sources.rule: These live in the git repository, never on the runtime filesystem.

key_files.infra/registry.json: Primary runtime placement registry. SSOT for node topology, transport URIs, credential references, lifecycle.
key_files.infra/runtime-authority.json: Operational authority map: surfaces, installed state paths, service projections, canonical capabilities.
key_files.infra/directory-tree.json: THIS FILE — canonical filesystem arborescence. SSOT for all paths.
key_files.infra/agent-source-protocol.json: Source governance: remotes, commit convention, branch policy, PR flow, worktree isolation.
key_files.infra/storage-taxonomy.json: Data classification K1-K8 with storage homes and retention stories.
key_files.infra/surface-registry/: Surface registry: which crate owns which CLI surface, commands, entrypoints, evidence schemas.

installed_system.description: K6/K8 boundary — installed runtime state owned by cynic principal. Not under operator home. Materialized from git at deploy time.

key_paths.registry.json: Materialized copy of infra/registry.json for installed runtime. Authored by git, consumed by runtime.
key_paths.secrets/: K8 secrets — never in git. 0640 cynic:cynic. Contains forgejo-token, github-deploy-key, proxmox-token, etc.
key_paths.identity/: Machine identity material. node-identity.key, node-identity.cert, node-signing.key, artifact-store-token, release-signing-key, enrollment-*.json, proxmox-credential-*.json
key_paths.runtime-allowed-signers: Allowed signers for runtime seed verification.
key_paths.runtime-seed-allowed-signers: Allowed signers for runtime seed verification.

runtime_state.description: K2/K3/K5 — operational state, evidence, artifacts. Owned by cynic principal.

key_paths.runtime/: Installed runtime binaries and current symlink.
key_paths.source/: Source checkout and workspaces for agent workloads.
key_paths.source/repositories/CYNIC: CYNIC repository checkout (canonical working tree for builds).
key_paths.evidence/: K1 — immutable evidence. Append-only signed journals.
key_paths.sandboxes/: Agent sandbox worktrees. Pattern: /var/lib/cynic/sandboxes/workload-{id}/repo.git and workspace.
key_paths.reports/: Audit and diagnostic reports (derived, not authority).
key_paths.vault/: K5 — model vault (GGUF weights, etc.). CAS sha256 manifest.

operator_user.description: User-space operator data. NOT runtime authority. Projections and convenience only.

home_cynic_principal.description: Service principal home for cynic user.

path_resolution.description: How paths are resolved at runtime. Follows runtime_paths.rs logic.
precedence: 3. Installed system (/etc/cynic, /var/lib/cynic) when cynic principal exists
4. Dev worktree fallback (infra/registry.json in current git tree)

expansions.${GIT_WORKING_TREE}: Current git working tree root (resolved by finding infra/registry.json ancestor).

data_classification_ref.description: Cross-reference to storage-taxonomy.json data kinds. Every path MUST map to exactly one K-kind.

anti_rules: No path hardcoding outside this document — use runtime_paths resolution.
No secrets in git (K8 never in git/db).
No operator home as runtime authority when principal is resolvable.
No duplication of git sources into databases (K6 lives in git).
No conflating installed system paths with operator user paths.
